answer.question: Prepare the registration for WS-25-4520, but don't submit anything.
answer.answer:
I drafted the registration for WS-25-4520 via the warranty desk agent — nothing was submitted. Key details: Welding Station WS-250, sold 2026-02-20 to Contoso Fleet Services, 24-month full parts/labor coverage ending 2028-02-20, with a registration deadline of 2026-03-22 (20 days left).

Before actually submitting, confirm the sale date on the invoice and the customer contact with Priya Raman, then file it in the manufacturer's portal yourself.
